rationale.text: The html element has no language attribute; the header carries lang="fr", but the main content does not, and none of its parents does. The page is invalid by the first condition, and the second, which asks for the indication on each text element or one of its parents, fails for the paragraphs of the main content. The custom check faults on the first uncovered witness, the heading of the main content (step 3), so the finding is failed at both levels.

citations.quote: L’indication de la langue de la page (attribut `lang` et/ou `xml:lang`) est donnée pour l’élément `html`
L’indication de la langue de la page (attribut `lang` et/ou `xml:lang`) est donnée sur chaque élément de texte ou sur l’un des éléments parents.
Sinon, vérifier la présence d’une indication de langue sur chaque élément de texte ou l’un de ses parents.
